Regulation: B.C. Reg. 148/2026
Made under: Special Accounts Appropriation And Control Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 24, 2026

B.C. Reg. 148/2026, deposited July 24, 2026, under theSPECIAL ACCOUNTS APPROPRIATION AND CONTROL ACT[section 9.9 (14)]. Regulation of Treasury Board, dated July 24, 2026. Treasury Board orders that the attached British Columbia Strategic Investments Regulation is made. — B. BAILEY,Chair, Treasury Board. BRITISH COLUMBIA STRATEGIC INVESTMENTS  REGULATION 1In this regulation,"Act"means theSpecial Accounts Appropriation and Control Act. Qualification to be eligible recipient 2A person must, in order to be an eligible recipient for the purposes of section 9.9 of the Act, be registered to carry on business in British Columbia. 3For the purposes of section 9.9 of the Act, the following activities are prescribed as strategic investments: (a)	the construction, manufacturing, conversion, maintenance, repair, overhaul or recycling of marine vessels suitable or intended for other than personal or recreational use; (b)	the mining, extracting, beneficiating, milling, recycling or processing, by any other method, of minerals; (c)	the manufacturing, including research and development leading to the manufacturing, of (i)	drugs or related products for human or animal use, (ii)	medical equipment or supplies, or (iii)	products supporting work in the physical, engineering or life sciences; (d)	the design or construction of electrical or digital infrastructure for artificial intelligence or quantum technologies, including (i)	manufacturing computer components or systems, (ii)	developing data processing systems, including research and development, (iii)	manufacturing semiconductors or other electronic components, or (iv)	developing, modifying, testing or supporting software or information architecture; (e)	the manufacturing, including research and development leading to the manufacturing, engineering, repairing or maintenance of aircraft, space vehicles or their parts, auxiliary equipment or systems;

minutes_briefs.title: BC opens strategic investment funding to shipbuilding, mining, life sciences, AI and aerospace businesses
minutes_briefs.summary: BC has created a new regulation under the Special Accounts Appropriation and Control Act that defines which activities count as 'strategic investments' for a special government account. The listed activities are: building or repairing non-recreational marine vessels; mining and processing minerals; making drugs, medical equipment or life-science products; designing or building electrical or digital infrastructure for artificial intelligence and quantum technologies (including semiconductors and software); and manufacturing or maintaining aircraft and space vehicles. To qualify for money from this account, a business must be registered to carry on business in British Columbia.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Confirm your business is registered to carry on business in BC if you plan to apply for funding under this strategic investments program.
minutes_briefs.industries: Natural Resources, Technology, Healthcare, Transportation & Logistics
